text: DSH OpenAI Quota（DSH Web 插件）：在顶部状态浮层展示 ChatGPT/Codex 当前及每周额度、重置时间、重置卡数量与最近到期时间，以及 DeepSeek 账户余额。Host 读取 DSH 已有的 ChatGPT 登录凭据并请求额度信息，Client 注册 shell.overlay 并定时刷新；点击重置卡信息可打开 ChatGPT 使用情况页。适合想快速查看账户用量的用户。需先在 DSH 登录 ChatGPT/Codex；DeepSeek 登录为余额显示的可选条件，不需要额外 API key。

DSH OpenAI Quota shows ChatGPT/Codex quota and reset times, reset-card expiry, and DeepSeek balance in DSH Web. It refreshes data and opens the ChatGPT usage page from the reset-card link. Requires a ChatGPT/Codex sign-in; DeepSeek sign-in is optional. No extra API key is needed.
想在 DSH 页面顶部随时看到 ChatGPT 当前额度和重置时间。
有没有办法在一个状态行里同时查看 DeepSeek 余额和 Codex 周额度？
I want a DSH overlay for ChatGPT quota and reset-card expiry.
**DSH OpenAI Quota** 的功能「显示账户余额与额度」：浮层展示 DeepSeek 钱包余额、ChatGPT 当前及每周额度和各自重置时间；额度数据由 Host 汇总，Client 定时刷新。
**DSH OpenAI Quota** 的功能「查看并打开重置卡信息」：浮层列出仍可用重置卡的数量和最近到期时间；点击该片段会打开 ChatGPT 使用情况页。
DSH OpenAI Quota 使用前须知：查询 ChatGPT/Codex 额度需要 DSH 中已有的 ChatGPT OAuth 登录凭据；插件将额度请求发送到 chatgpt.com。
DSH OpenAI Quota 使用前须知：余额功能通过 DSH 的 DeepSeek 账户服务读取登录账户余额；DeepSeek 未登录时该项不可用。

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · dsh-plugin-openai-quota：**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Issues](https://github.com/pythoner1984/dsh-plugin-openai-quota/issues)

A one-line quota notice for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH). It sits at the top edge of the Web UI, stays out of the way, and never opens a panel:

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · dsh-plugin-openai-quota：*A live DSH window (sidebar redacted). The notice runs along the top edge: DeepSeek balance, the current and weekly ChatGPT quota with their reset times, and the nearest reset-card expiry. The numbers are whatever your account reports at that moment:*

```
DeepSeek余额：65.2元 | OpenAI额度26%（80%） 重置时间：12:10（11月7日） | 重置卡：1张 11月7日 05:23到期
```

Everything comes from accounts you are already signed in to. No API key is created, copied, or stored by this plugin.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · What it shows：| Segment | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeek balance | DSH `deepseekAccount.getBalance()` | CNY wallet, one decimal |
| OpenAI current quota + reset time | `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage` → `rate_limit.primary_window` | remaining % of the 5-hour window, reset time in `HH:mm` |
| OpenAI weekly quota + weekly reset | same response → `rate_limit.secondary_window` | remaining % of the weekly window, reset date |
| Reset cards | `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/rate-limit-reset-credits` | nearest expiry of the cards that are still `available` and supported by your plan |

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · What it shows：Clicking the reset-card segment opens the ChatGPT usage page in the operating system's default browser. The plugin only *tells* you about reset cards — it never redeems one.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · How it works：- **Host half (`index.js`)** reads the existing ChatGPT OAuth grant from DSH's credential store (`llm-pi-ai/openai-codex`), calls the two `chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/*` endpoints, reads the DeepSeek balance through the official `deepseekAccount` service, and serves four authenticated routes.
- **Client half (`client.js`)** registers one `shell.overlay` entry (`id: openai-quota`, `order: 600`), fetches `/openai-quota/summary`, and renders a fixed, click-through, non-interactive status line. It refreshes every 15 minutes, and immediately when the page becomes visible again.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · How it works：| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/openai-quota/summary` | GET | everything the notice renders |
| `/openai-quota/usage` | GET | raw quota windows only |
| `/openai-quota/health` | GET | redacted self-check (see Troubleshooting) |
| `/openai-quota/reset-card/open` | POST | opens the usage page in the default browser |

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (desktop app or `dsh web`).
- A ChatGPT/Codex sign-in already configured in DSH — this is what supplies the OpenAI quota.
- Optional: a signed-in DeepSeek account for the balance segment. Without it the balance renders as `—`.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Install：Clone the repository somewhere permanent, then install it as a local bundle with the DSH Plugin Manager:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pythoner1984/dsh-plugin-openai-quota.git
```

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target: <absolute path to the clone>
```

After a `git pull`, reinstall the bundle (or restart DSH) so the new code is loaded.

Or insert it into your own Cordis composition:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: openai-quota
      name: 'dsh-plugin-openai-quota'
```
dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Install：Removing the bundle removes the overlay entry; no state is left behind.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Configuration：None. The refresh interval, timezone (`Asia/Shanghai`), and target URLs are constants so the plugin cannot be pointed at another host or turned into an open redirect. Fork the repo if you want different values.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Security and privacy：- **No admin key, ever.** The plugin reuses the OAuth grant DSH already holds; it never asks for an `sk-…` key.
- **Credentials stay Host-side.** The browser only ever sees percentages, timestamps, and card counts — the access token never leaves the Host process.
- **Every route sits behind the local trust check** (`connection.requestRejection`) and fails closed: no connection service → `503 local-auth-unavailable`, rejected call → `401/403`, guard throws → `403 local-auth-failed`.
- **Method allowlists per route**, so a browser `GET` cannot trigger the opener (`405 method-not-allowed`).
- **No request input reaches the browser command.** The URL is a Host constant and is passed as its own `spawn` argument; nothing from the request is interpolated into a shell.
- **Minimal upstream payload.** Account email, plan type, and credit details are dropped on the Host before anything is returned.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Known limits：- The `chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/*` endpoints are internal to the ChatGPT web app. They can change or disappear at any time; the notice degrades to `—` / `暂不可用` instead of breaking the UI.
- In the **desktop app** the shell hands `window.open` to the default browser and returns no window handle, so the usage page opens at the top — the notice cannot scroll it to the reset-card section. When the GUI runs in a real browser tab, the plugin re-navigates that tab with a text-fragment directive and *does* land on the reset-card section.
- Reset times are always rendered in `Asia/Shanghai`, not the local timezone of the machine.
- The quota windows are reported as ChatGPT labels them (`primary_window` = 5-hour, `secondary_window` = weekly). If your plan exposes different windows, the labels simply follow the data.

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `credentialConfigured: false` | No ChatGPT sign-in found for `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex`; sign in to ChatGPT in DSH first |
| `usageError: "upstream-http"` + `upstreamStatus: 401` | The OAuth grant expired — sign in again |
| `usageError: "upstream-unreachable"` | Network/proxy blocked `chatgpt.com` |
| `windows.primary_window: false` | The upstream response changed shape; the notice shows `—` |
| Notice shows `读取失败` | The summary route failed or the browser lost the local auth cookie |
| Clicking the reset card does nothing | The notice sits inside the desktop window's drag strip; the link already sets `-webkit-app-region: no-drag`, so report an issue with your DSH version |

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Development：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: credentials, upstream fetch, routes, opener |
| `client.js` | Client half: overlay registration, rendering, refresh, open-in-browser |
| `host.test.mjs` | route registration/rollback, trust checks, reset-card parsing, opener arguments |
| `client.test.mjs` | rendering states, reset-card text, click behaviour in browser vs desktop shell |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | composition patch that inserts the plugin |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin Manager metadata |
dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · Development：The client half is plain ESM wrapped in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`; tests load it with `new Function` and a fake React, so no bundler is needed.

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）用的一行额度提示。贴在 Web UI 顶部边缘，不弹面板、不需要点击展开：

*实拍的 DSH 窗口（侧栏已打码）。提示横在顶部边缘：DeepSeek 余额、当前与每周 ChatGPT 额度及其重置时间、最近一张重置卡的到期时间。数字就是账号当时返回的值：*

```
DeepSeek余额：65.2元 | OpenAI额度26%（80%） 重置时间：12:10（11月7日） | 重置卡：1张 11月7日 05:23到期
```

数据全部来自你已经登录的账号，插件不创建、不复制、不保存任何 API key。

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 显示什么：| 片段 | 来源 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeek 余额 | DSH `deepseekAccount.getBalance()` | 人民币钱包，保留一位小数 |
| OpenAI 当前额度 + 重置时间 | `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage` → `rate_limit.primary_window` | 5 小时窗口剩余百分比，重置时间 `HH:mm` |
| OpenAI 周额度 + 周重置 | 同一响应 → `rate_limit.secondary_window` | 每周窗口剩余百分比与重置日期 |
| 重置卡 | `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/rate-limit-reset-credits` | 状态为 `available` 且套餐支持的卡里最近的一张到期时间 |

点击「重置卡」片段会用系统默认浏览器打开 ChatGPT 使用情况页。插件只做**提示**，不会替你消耗重置卡。

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 工作原理：- **Host 半（`index.js`）**从 DSH 凭据库读取已有的 ChatGPT OAuth 授权（`llm-pi-ai/openai-codex`），调用两个 `chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/*` 接口，通过官方 `deepseekAccount` 服务读取余额，并注册四个需鉴权的路由。
- **Client 半（`client.js`）**在 `shell.overlay` 注册一个条目（`id: openai-quota`，`order: 600`），拉取 `/openai-quota/summary`，渲染一条固定、可穿透点击、不可交互的状态行。每 15 分钟刷新一次，页面重新可见时立即刷新。

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 工作原理：| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/openai-quota/summary` | GET | 提示行需要的全部数据 |
| `/openai-quota/usage` | GET | 仅额度窗口原始数据 |
| `/openai-quota/health` | GET | 脱敏自检（见「排查」） |
| `/openai-quota/reset-card/open` | POST | 用默认浏览器打开使用情况页 |

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 环境要求：- 带 Web UI 的 DeepSeek Harness（桌面应用或 `dsh web`）。
- DSH 里已经配置好的 ChatGPT / Codex 登录 —— OpenAI 额度就来自它。
- 可选：已登录的 DeepSeek 账号用于余额片段；没有时余额显示为 `—`。

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 安装：先把仓库克隆到一个固定位置，再用 DSH 插件管理器安装本地 bundle：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pythoner1984/dsh-plugin-openai-quota.git
```

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target: <克隆目录绝对路径>
```

`git pull` 之后重新安装一次 bundle（或重启 DSH）才会加载新代码。

或者写进自己的 Cordis 组合：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: openai-quota
      name: 'dsh-plugin-openai-quota'
```

卸载 bundle 即移除该浮层条目，不残留状态。
dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 配置：没有配置项。刷新间隔、时区（`Asia/Shanghai`）和目标 URL 都是常量，插件无法被指向别的主机，也不会变成开放重定向。需要别的行为请 fork。

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 安全与隐私：- **永远不需要 admin key。** 复用 DSH 已持有的 OAuth 授权，从不索取 `sk-…`。
- **凭据只留在 Host 端。** 浏览器只会拿到百分比、时间戳和卡数量，access token 不离开 Host 进程。
- **所有路由都在本地信任检查之后**，且失败关闭：没有 connection 服务 → `503 local-auth-unavailable`，被拒绝 → `401/403`，守卫抛异常 → `403 local-auth-failed`。
- **逐路由方法白名单**，浏览器 `GET` 无法触发打开动作（`405 method-not-allowed`）。
- **请求内容不会进入浏览器命令。** URL 是 Host 常量，作为独立参数传给 `spawn`，请求里的任何内容都不会拼进命令行。
- **上游数据最小化。** 账号邮箱、套餐类型、额度明细在 Host 端就被丢弃，不会返回给浏览器。

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 已知限制：- `chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/*` 是 ChatGPT 网页版的内部接口，可能随时变化或下线；届时提示行降级成 `—` / `暂不可用`，不会把 UI 弄坏。
- **桌面应用**里，外壳会把 `window.open` 交给系统默认浏览器并且不返回窗口句柄，因此使用情况页只能停在顶部，无法自动滚到「使用限额重置」区块。当 GUI 跑在真实浏览器标签页里时，插件会用文本片段指令重新导航该标签页，可以精确落在重置卡区块。
- 重置时间固定按 `Asia/Shanghai` 渲染，不随机器时区变化。
- 额度窗口按 ChatGPT 自己的标签解释（`primary_window` = 5 小时，`secondary_window` = 每周）。如果你的套餐暴露别的窗口，文案会跟着数据走。

{
  "ok": true,

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 排查：| 现象 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `credentialConfigured: false` | 没找到 `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` 的登录凭据，先在 DSH 里登录 ChatGPT |
| `usageError: "upstream-http"` + `upstreamStatus: 401` | OAuth 授权过期，重新登录 |
| `usageError: "upstream-unreachable"` | 网络/代理挡住了 `chatgpt.com` |
| `windows.primary_window: false` | 上游响应结构变了，提示行显示 `—` |
| 提示行显示 `读取失败` | summary 路由失败，或浏览器丢了本地鉴权 cookie |
| 点重置卡没反应 | 提示行压在桌面窗口拖拽条上；链接已设置 `-webkit-app-region: no-drag`，仍失败请带 DSH 版本提 issue |

dsh-plugin-openai-quota README · 开发：```bash
npm test        # node --test，两半共 22 项断言
```

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 半：凭据、上游请求、路由、打开浏览器 |
| `client.js` | Client 半：浮层注册、渲染、轮询、打开浏览器 |
| `host.test.mjs` | 路由注册与回滚、信任检查、重置卡解析、打开命令参数 |
| `client.test.mjs` | 各渲染状态、重置卡文案、浏览器与桌面外壳下的点击行为 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入插件的组合补丁 |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | 插件管理器元数据 |

Client 半是包在 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 里的普通 ESM；测试用 `new Function` 加假 React 直接加载，不需要打包器。
